XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Headlight washer relay

  • Fault: Failure to start and/or switch off, various malfunctions of interior functions such as active direction indicators, failure of low beam headlights, etc.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Interference caused by headlight washer relays in the fuse box

• Task: Replace the two headlight washer relays

  • Procedure: To check whether the series of faults is due to interference caused by the headlamp washer relays in the engine compartment fuse box, ensure that:
    • With the engine switched off , the warning “Electronic fault” appears on the instrument panel, with the immobiliser warning light and the side indicators illuminated continuously.
    • With the engine running , the instrument cluster faults persist; furthermore, the dipped-beam headlights come on, and the front electric fan and front windscreen wipers are activated.
    If the vehicle exhibits this behaviour, the fault is caused by the headlamp washer system relays. Replace the two headlamp washer system relays in the engine compartment fuse box with the new versions (product code 8200337663).

  • Note: If the car is fitted with the headlamp washer system, replace the two relays in question.
    If the car is not fitted with the headlamp washer system, it may still be equipped with the two relays; in this case, simply remove the two relays in question.
